name: oshn
description: Plugins and mods that help you understand what Claude does: legible answer formats, a live session board, and lean code you accept item by item.

plugins.name: legible
plugins.description: Answer formats for understanding, after Karpathy's format ladder: ASD-STE100 text, diagrams, HTML explainers, animated step players, teach-back.

plugins.name: session-board
plugins.description: Desktop mod for people who run many sessions: a task brief at the start, an acceptance screen and an HTML report at the end, and a task folder that survives compaction.

plugins.name: lean
plugins.description: Claude writes the least code that solves the problem and says what it skipped, in plain words; with session-board, each skipped thing is a decision you accept. Based on ponytail by Dietrich Gebert.

plugins.name: notion-tasks
plugins.description: Run a project's work through your own Notion task board: take a ticket, keep its status, write the closing report, file follow-ups. Works with any Notion connection; with session-board the ticket becomes the brief and Acceptance closes it.

plugins.name: obsidian-tasks
plugins.description: Run a project's work through the roadmap board in your Obsidian vault (Kanban plugin or Bases): take a ticket, keep its status, write the closing report, file follow-ups. You choose the access at setup: the vault folder, the Obsidian CLI or your Obsidian MCP server.
